unit.why: A short anecdote in which R. Moshe Teitelbaum boasts to the Seer of Lublin that studying the Guide left him with no doubts and the Seer explains why, followed by two appended sayings of R. Pinchas of Korets on Rashi and on lying.
unit.boundary_note: the division ends with appended sayings of R. Pinchas of Korets that are teachings, not narrative

stories.start_quote: הה״ק ר׳ משה טייטעלבוים זצ״ל מאוהל התפאר
stories.end_quote: שקר חמור כמו עריות יבא משיח
stories.summary_en: R. Moshe Teitelbaum of Ujhely boasts to the Seer of Lublin that he studied Maimonides' Guide without being left with doubts; the Seer attributes this to his having learned Chumash with Rashi from his uncle R. Yosef of Kolbuszowa, and sayings of R. Pinchas of Korets on Rashi as conducive to faith and on lying follow.

tags.why: the exchange is between the disciple and his master, the Seer of Lublin
